fusions.name: Startle Burst
fusions.desc: A burst that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 3 tiles and has a 50% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: First Notice
fusions.desc: Flicks a quick sting at the first enemy in its path for 4 damage, with 30% more critical chance against a target not yet hurt.

fusions.name: Scattering Bound
fusions.desc: You leap 3 tiles, then move 30% faster for 8 seconds with +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Ever Watchful
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled again and the second roll stands. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
